database_summary: This is a small bowling league / tournament schema in SQLite. Core entities are Bowlers, Teams, Tournaments and Tourney_Matches. Match-level results are stored in Match_Games and per-bowler scores in Bowler_Scores. Several _Archive tables mirror live tables but are empty in the provided profile. WAZips is a zipcode lookup for WA locations. The schema mixes descriptive entities (teams, bowlers, tournaments), event/measurement rows (match games and bowler scores) and archive copies for historical storage.

accepted.name: bowler_scores_enriched
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  bs.MatchID AS MatchID,
  bs.GameNumber AS GameNumber,
  bs.BowlerID AS BowlerID,
  bs.RawScore AS RawScore,
  bs.HandiCapScore AS HandiCapScore,
  bs.WonGame AS WonGame,
  b.BowlerLastName AS BowlerLastName,
  b.BowlerFirstName AS BowlerFirstName,
  b.BowlerMiddleInit AS BowlerMiddleInit,
  b.TeamID AS TeamID,
  t.TeamName AS TeamName,
  tm.TourneyID AS TourneyID,
  tn.TourneyDate AS TourneyDate,
  tn.TourneyLocation AS TourneyLocation,
  tm.Lanes AS Lanes,
  mg.WinningTeamID AS WinningTeamID
FROM Bowler_Scores AS bs
LEFT JOIN Bowlers AS b
  ON bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
LEFT JOIN Teams AS t
  ON b.TeamID = t.TeamID
LEFT JOIN Match_Games AS mg
  ON bs.MatchID = mg.MatchID
  AND bs.GameNumber = mg.GameNumber
LEFT JOIN Tourney_Matches AS tm
  ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
LEFT JOIN Tournaments AS tn
  ON tm.TourneyID = tn.TourneyID

semantic_filters.none: no forced filters; use downstream WHERE to limit by date/team/bowler/etc.

accepted.description: Denormalized per-bowler-per-game scores joined to bowler, match, team and tournament context. Use this when you need bowler-level results with identifying attributes (bowler name, team, match lanes, tournament date/location) for aggregations, filters, or downstream ranking. | Use for: List scores and handicaps for bowlers in a given tournament/date/team/match; Compute per-bowler aggregates (avg score, total pins) within tournaments or across season; Find which bowlers won games and which team won the game

Useful as a canonical per-bowler metrics table for joining to other relations or ranking bowlers by performance. | Use for: Rank bowlers by current average or total pins; Join per-bowler current stats to recent tournament performance; Filter bowlers by team and compute roster-level aggregates

accepted.name: team_match_results
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  tm.MatchID AS MatchID,
  tm.TourneyID AS TourneyID,
  tm.Lanes AS Lanes,
  tm.OddLaneTeamID AS OddLaneTeamID,
  tm.EvenLaneTeamID AS EvenLaneTeamID,
  mg.GameNumber AS GameNumber,
  mg.WinningTeamID AS WinningTeamID,
  CASE WHEN tm.OddLaneTeamID = mg.WinningTeamID THEN tm.OddLaneTeamID
       WHEN tm.EvenLaneTeamID = mg.WinningTeamID THEN tm.EvenLaneTeamID
       ELSE NULL END AS WinningTeamInMatch,
  -- expose per-game boolean flags for odd/even team win
  CASE WHEN tm.OddLaneTeamID = mg.WinningTeamID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS OddLaneWonFlag,
  CASE WHEN tm.EvenLaneTeamID = mg.WinningTeamID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS EvenLaneWonFlag
FROM Tourney_Matches AS tm
JOIN Match_Games AS mg
  ON tm.MatchID = mg.MatchID

semantic_filters.none: no forced filters; keep all matches/games

accepted.description: Team-level results per match aggregated from Match_Games and Tourney_Matches. Produces one row per match-team combination showing whether the team was odd/even lane, whether they won each game, and tournament context. Useful for team standings, match-level win/loss summaries, and joining to team rosters. | Use for: Compute team match wins across a tournament or season; Identify which lane (odd/even) tends to win more games; Join to Teams to produce standings or captain-level reports

accepted.name: bowler_game_rank_within_match
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  bs.MatchID AS MatchID,
  bs.GameNumber AS GameNumber,
  bs.BowlerID AS BowlerID,
  bs.RawScore AS RawScore,
  bs.HandiCapScore AS HandiCapScore,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY bs.MatchID, bs.GameNumber ORDER BY bs.RawScore DESC) AS RawScoreRank,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY bs.MatchID, bs.GameNumber ORDER BY bs.HandiCapScore DESC) AS HandiCapRank
FROM Bowler_Scores AS bs

semantic_filters.none: no forced filters; downstream queries can filter RawScoreRank <= k or HandiCapRank <= k

accepted.description: Ranks bowlers within each match and game by RawScore and by HandiCapScore (dense rank). Useful for answering top-k questions per game or producing medalists for each game/match while preserving ties. | Use for: Return top N bowlers by raw or handicap score per game/match; Identify ties and rankings within a match/game

accepted.name: bowler_running_totals_in_tourney
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  be.BowlerID AS BowlerID,
  be.TourneyID AS TourneyID,
  be.MatchID AS MatchID,
  be.GameNumber AS GameNumber,
  be.RawScore AS RawScore,
  be.HandiCapScore AS HandiCapScore,
  SUM(be.RawScore) OVER (PARTITION BY be.TourneyID, be.BowlerID ORDER BY be.MatchID, be.GameNumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS CumulativeRawScore,
  SUM(be.HandiCapScore) OVER (PARTITION BY be.TourneyID, be.BowlerID ORDER BY be.MatchID, be.GameNumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS CumulativeHandiCapScore
FROM (
  SELECT
    bs.MatchID AS MatchID,
    bs.GameNumber AS GameNumber,
    bs.BowlerID AS BowlerID,
    bs.RawScore AS RawScore,
    bs.HandiCapScore AS HandiCapScore,
    tm.TourneyID AS TourneyID
  FROM Bowler_Scores AS bs
  LEFT JOIN Tourney_Matches AS tm
    ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
) AS be

semantic_filters.none: no forced filters; TourneyID may be NULL for scores not linked to a tournament

accepted.description: Running totals of RawScore and HandiCapScore per bowler within a tournament ordered by MatchID and GameNumber. Produces one row per bowler-game with cumulative pins; useful for tracking cumulative scoring across a tournament for leaderboards or momentum analysis. | Use for: Show running totals per bowler across a tournament; Produce leaderboards at each round of a tournament

accepted.name: zip_lookup_for_bowlers
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.BowlerID AS BowlerID,
  b.BowlerLastName AS BowlerLastName,
  b.BowlerFirstName AS BowlerFirstName,
  b.BowlerCity AS BowlerCity,
  b.BowlerState AS BowlerState,
  b.BowlerZip AS BowlerZip,
  wz.City AS City,
  wz.State AS State
FROM Bowlers AS b
LEFT JOIN WAZips AS wz
  ON b.BowlerZip = wz.ZIP

semantic_filters.none: no forced filters; join is left so bowlers without WA ZIP still appear

accepted.description: Maps bowlers' BowlerZip to WA city/state using WAZips. Useful to enrich bowler addresses with canonical city/state and to group/filter bowlers by region. | Use for: Group bowlers by city/state for regional reports; Validate or enrich bowler address data using ZIP table
